resources.string: Listening in French… (press OK for English)
PG Prime isn\'t installed, or is too old for voice

Opens with the mic button: %1$s
Google speech recognition: %2$s
PG Prime for searches: %3$s
Gemini key for AI search in PG Prime: %4$s

What you say is turned into text by Google's speech recognition, as with PG Prime's mic. With a Gemini key, the words of PG Prime searches (not YouTube, not commands like "pause") go to Gemini, which fixes misheard words and picks Search or Scout.

Things to say (French or English):
• "The Matrix", "cherche Dune" → PG Prime search
• "a movie about magic", "un film de magie" → Scout
• "cat videos on YouTube", "une vidéo YouTube sur…" → SmartTube
• "open Arte", "ouvre Eclipse" → opens the app
• "pause", "play", "next", "volume up", "coupe le son", "home"
